issues: The card faces were saturated red / purple / blue gradient blocks with 'CARD 01' placeholder text, like colour swatches with no readable product content
The ring spun at a dead-constant rate for 5.6s with no pause where any card could be read and no hero
The ring filled only a small patch of the frame (92×124 cards in design units) surrounded by empty black, with no caption or information layer
A flat dark ground with barely visible floor and reflection left the ring floating in mid-air
changes: Switched to the lime look (graphite with neon yellow-green): cards scaled to 340×460 on a 700px radius so the ring spans about 70% of the frame; faces rebuilt as training-plan cards (mono index, generative graphic, 72px stat, 32px name)

Rotation is now 50% constant base plus 50% stepped (every 21f = 8f dwell + 13f smooth move), so the ring never stops but gets a push-and-dock every 45°; 8 steps make exactly one turn, so the first and last frames still loop seamlessly

The card facing the camera lights up within ±26° of azimuth: neon outline, graphic colour interpolated from graphite grey to neon, and a 44px push out along its normal (translation only, so it stays upright)
Added a caption under the ring with a mono index and a 72px name that rolls up in a clipping window on each step; an eyebrow top-left and week counter top-right frame the shot

The floor gains a 2.7×-radius reflective disc and a 96-tick ring that turns with the carousel, the reflection drops to 8% with a longer fade, and aerial-perspective darkening goes up to 70%; the camera stays locked at a shallow overhead angle
